Profile

I design retrieval pipelines, tool-calling agents and the interfaces around them. The work centres on grounded answers: the model reads from a defined source, shows where an answer came from, and asks for approval before it sends or changes anything.

My projects cover document question answering on Azure, an email agent with human approval, and a business analyst agent that chooses between analysis tools on its own.

Based in Giza, Egypt. Available for freelance AI projects.

AI Business Analyst

Ask questions about a sales file in plain language. A model picks from five hand-coded analysis tools (total revenue, monthly sales, top products, customer statistics, period comparison) and a ReAct-style loop runs them. Built with a teammate in Python, with OpenRouter models and a Gradio interface.

RAG Agent

A policy assistant that answers from company documents and keeps internal HR policy behind a login. Customers get answers from the public policy PDF. Employee questions switch the agent to a second index only after it verifies a name and passcode, so a visitor cannot reach internal documents by asking for them.

  • LangChain agents
  • Retrieval tool calling
  • Role-based access
  • Model fallback
  • Gradio
